Opus regression inputs are actual libopus-encoded packets from locally generated Piper speech. Each packet is prefixed by its unsigned 16-bit little-endian byte length. Generated with FFmpeg 9.0.2 libopus at 48 kHz: stereo, 64 kbps, 20 ms; mono, 32 kbps, 60 ms. They exercise browser-compatible stereo and aggregated frames independently of the decoder implementation. No network or speech provider is required to replay the fixtures.
